commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text: Those who like to sin with the wife of a man who doesn’t suspect them are dead, though they have life. They are no different from the dead because their souls gain none of righteousness, wealth and pleasure. “One who trusts” is said because they can do this only through the husband’s trust.
